title: Individual wells
text:
19.12.040 Individual wells.
A.	Within the Corporate City Limits. Individual wells within the corporate city limits of El Paso shall be discouraged. If, in a unique case, an exception is granted to a single property that may not otherwise be served by the authorized local health agent or department with jurisdiction to utilize individual wells, such individual well shall meet all requirements for individual wells contained in Chapter 19.11.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
Chapter 19.13 WASTEWATER
